title: Resource map: where things live
summary: A map of the knowledge base’s major sections, so the reader can find the right page fast instead of memorizing the contents.

atoms.title: Hardening
atoms.body: Before detection comes prevention: DNS, email, general endpoint and network security, the Microsoft 365 surface (Auditing, Azure AD, Exchange, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams), Active Directory, Windows DNS, Windows itself, network, remote access, vendor guidance and web security all have their own hardening page here — one destination per topic, not one giant document.

atoms.title: Detection & Compliance Matrix, Data Enrichment, Lab
atoms.body: The Detection and Compliance Matrix links cases, adversaries, techniques, mitigations, detections, hunts and log sources together as one relational structure, with Detection Tactics, Detection Methods and Playbooks underneath it. Data Enrichment lists what turns a bare log field into something searchable — GeoIP/ASN, Levenshtein distance, Shannon entropy, WHOIS, reverse-DNS, certificate parsing and a few ready-made lookup tables. Lab is where all of it gets exercised, against a real Windows system, SIEM and attacking system.
